title: Apache Superset — selected source-file map
method: Count Git tree blob entries under each exact directory prefix matching its include regex and not its exclude regex. Count paths, not lines, test cases, integrations, installed services, coverage, runtime size or performance. Matching tests, declarations and generated files are included unless excluded explicitly. Git submodules are not expanded. Only listed roots are counted; the selection is not a repository-wide denominator.
limitation: Static inventory only; the contents of every counted file were not reviewed. Counts must not be compared as product quality, security, speed or maintenance-effort scores.
caption: Static file counts in selected roots at commit b44ea299259b. Includes matching tests and generated files; not performance, coverage or a whole-repository breakdown.
interpretation: SQL Lab, security, asynchronous task and web UI roots are useful entry points for the operational boundaries discussed above. The inventory excludes other backend and plugin directories, and includes matching tests where they are co-located.
adoptionCheck: Assign owners for database privileges, application roles and background work before evaluating a dashboard rollout. The UI file count does not predict query cost, concurrency capacity or security quality.

claim.claim: The source-map values count the retained matching Git blob paths for the selected roots at this commit.
claim.evidenceType: direct Git tree inventory; reviewer-selected grouping
claim.locator: groups[].source identifies the tree; groups[].prefix/includePattern/excludePattern define selection; groups[].files lists every counted path and blob ID.
claim.limitation: Tree entry counts do not verify behavior or quality. Content review remains limited to the original cited excerpts.
